column1: # Rules of dm/tools/log_digest.py: what a line of an Android run log (or of its logcat) means, in one sentence a player understands. One rule a row, tab-separated:
#   kind   crash | fatal | red | driver | oom | hang | perf | info (the verdict uses the first matching rule of its own kind, in this file's order: specific rules first)
#   regex  searched in each line; must be valid in both Python re and Java java.util.regex (the launcher reads this table too): no named groups, no \Z, no (?P...),
#          no inline flags except a leading (?i) or a scoped (?i:...)
#   meaning  one to three plain English sentences: what happened and what to try
#   doc    a repository-relative link to the entry that explains it (file#anchor), or empty

column4: cause
column5: meaning

column4: The GPU stopped responding (a frame did not finish in time), so the game had to close.
column5: The graphics processor stopped responding while drawing a frame. Try picking another GPU driver in Settings › GPU driver or ⋯ › Game settings › GPU driver, or restart your phone.

column4: The GPU driver lost the device, so nothing more could be drawn.
column5: The graphics driver crashed and lost communication with the graphics processor. Try switching to another GPU driver in Settings › GPU driver or ⋯ › Game settings › GPU driver, or restart your phone.

column4: The GPU did not finish its work for seconds; the driver may be stuck.
column5: The graphics processor did not finish its work in time, likely due to a driver stall. Try picking another GPU driver in Settings › GPU driver, or restart your phone and try again.

column4: A texture upload did not finish in time; the GPU or its driver was stuck.
column5: Copying image data to the graphics processor timed out because the driver stalled. Try choosing a different GPU driver in Settings › GPU driver or ⋯ › Game settings › GPU driver, or restart your phone.

column4: The game process ran out of memory (an allocation failed).
column5: The game process ran out of available memory. Close other apps before playing, or turn on ⋯ › Game settings › RAM saver (uses storage). You can also lower the resolution in ⋯ › Game settings › Game resolution.

column4: An allocation in the host failed (std::bad_alloc): the process ran out of memory.
column5: The app could not allocate enough memory to keep running. Close background apps to free memory, or enable ⋯ › Game settings › RAM saver (uses storage) and lower Game resolution.

column4: Android's low-memory killer ended the game: the phone ran out of memory.
column5: Android closed the game because your phone was critically low on free memory. Close other open apps before playing, or enable ⋯ › Game settings › RAM saver (uses storage) and lower Game resolution.

column4: A line says the game or the host ran out of memory.
column5: The game or the app ran out of memory. Close background apps before playing, or enable ⋯ › Game settings › RAM saver (uses storage) to reduce memory pressure.

column4: The game stopped making progress and the watchdog (DM_WATCH_STALL) ended it.
column5: The game froze and stopped making progress, so it was closed. Try starting the game again, or try another GPU driver in Settings › GPU driver if it freezes repeatedly in the same spot.

column4: The run's time limit or watchdog (SIGALRM) ended it.
column5: The game was closed by a watchdog timer after it stopped responding. Start the game again, or tap Share log if the problem persists.

column4: The game did not finish its own exit in time and was ended at once.
column5: The game took too long to complete its exit and was closed immediately. No action is usually required, but if this occurs often you can tap Share log.

column3: game called nn::diag abort|FATAL game aborted
column4: The game's own code stopped itself (nn::diag abort): something it needed did not behave as on the console.
column5: The game encountered an internal error and stopped itself. Try launching the game again, or use ⋯ › Prepare again on the game card to re-prepare the pack.

column3: FATAL the game files .* (are missing|are not a complete RomFS image|cannot be used as a NUP package)
column4: The game files are missing or unreadable: check the game folder or .nup in the launcher.
column5: The game files could not be found or read. Check that your dump folder or .nup file still exists and has not been moved, or check ⋯ › Folders on the game card.

column4: A file the pack should have is missing: prepare the pack again.
column5: A file needed by the game pack is missing. Tap ⋯ › Prepare again on the game card to recreate the missing pack files.

column3: TLS_SLOT_APP .*another library uses the slot|thread slot layout mismatch
column4: Another library on this phone uses the thread slot the host needs, so the host cannot run here.
column5: Another background app or library on your phone is conflicting with system resources the game needs. Restart your phone and launch the game again.

column4: The game's code lacks a symbol the host needs: the pack does not fit this host.
column5: The prepared game pack does not match this version of the app. Tap ⋯ › Prepare again on the game card to update the pack.

column4: The game's memory block could not be reserved at its address.
column5: The app could not reserve the memory address space required for the game. Close other apps, restart your phone, and launch the game again.

column4: The save folder has an unfinished swap the host refuses to touch; move the marker away to use the save.
column5: The save folder contains an interrupted save file update. Use ⋯ › Restore saves on the game card to restore a backup, or check the folder in ⋯ › Folders.

column4: The game reached something the app cannot handle yet, so it was stopped.
column5: The game called a feature that this app does not support yet. Check Settings › Updates for a newer release, or tap Share log to report the issue.

column4: The game crashed while another thread held the log, so only the crash address was written.
column5: The game crashed while busy with background tasks. Launch the game again, or tap Share log if it crashes repeatedly at the same spot.

column4: The game crashed reading or writing memory it should not (SIGSEGV).
column5: The game tried to access an invalid memory location and crashed. Try starting the game again, try another GPU driver in Settings › GPU driver, or tap ⋯ › Prepare again on the game card.

column4: The game crashed on a bad memory access (SIGBUS).
column5: The game crashed because storage or memory could not be read properly. Make sure your phone has free space in Settings › Storage, or verify your storage if using an SD card.

column4: The game crashed on an instruction this CPU does not run (SIGILL).
column5: The game executed an instruction that your phone processor does not support. Tap ⋯ › Prepare again on the game card to make sure the code was prepared properly for your device.

column4: The game crashed on a trap instruction (SIGTRAP).
column5: The game triggered an internal error check and stopped. Try launching the game again, or tap Share log if it continues to crash in the same place.

column4: The process aborted (SIGABRT): the lines just before the crash say who called abort.
column5: The game or the app encountered an unrecoverable error and shut down. Restart the game, or tap Share log so the cause can be checked.

column4: The app ran into an error and had to close the game.
column5: An unexpected error occurred in the launcher itself. Restart the app, check Settings › Updates for an update, or tap Share log.

column4: Android reports a fatal signal in the game process.
column5: Android shut down the game process due to a critical crash. Restart your phone and launch the game again, or tap Share log if it persists.

column3: no shader library at .*nothing is drawn|shader library .* refused
column4: The pack has no usable shader library for this app, so nothing is drawn: update the shaders in the app.
column5: The game pack has no compatible graphics shaders for this app version. Tap Update shaders on the game card, or tap ⋯ › Prepare again to build them.

column4: The pack's shaders are from before versioned updates and may draw wrong: update the shaders once in the app.
column5: The game pack has older graphics shaders that may cause visual errors. Tap the Shaders need one update chip on the game card or run ⋯ › Prepare again to update them.

column3: its rewrite did not finish|Prepare again remakes it
column4: The pack's code was not finished: use Prepare again on the game.
column5: Preparing the game was interrupted before code processing completed. Tap ⋯ › Prepare again on the game card to finish preparing the game.

column4: A DLC folder of the dump could not be linked for the game.
column5: An add-on content folder could not be linked to the game. Check your game dump dlc folder in ⋯ › Folders, or tap ⋯ › Prepare again.

column4: env.txt exists but the app cannot read it, so the run had no switches: chmod 666 it.
column5: The diagnostic file env.txt exists but the app does not have permission to read it. Adjust its file permissions or delete env.txt to run with normal settings.

column4: Some environment lines set the game's paths and were not taken.
column5: Custom settings attempted to override protected app paths and were ignored. Remove any path settings from env.txt or ⋯ › Game settings › Extra environment.

column4: The phone was hot and slowed its CPU or GPU down; frame rate drops follow.
column5: Your phone became too warm and slowed down the processor to protect itself. Let the phone cool down before playing, or lower ⋯ › Game settings › Frame rate cap and Game resolution.

column3: Paused: the phone is too hot
column4: Prepare paused because the phone reported it was too hot.
column5: Game preparation paused because your phone reported high temperature. Let the phone cool down in a cool environment; preparation will resume automatically.

column3: this host's version \w+ is missing \(the app's shader update makes it\)
column4: The pack's shaders are an older version; the app's shader update makes the current one.
column5: The game is using older graphics shaders while an update is available. Tap Update shaders on the game card to update them in the background.

column4: The game sees no DLC; if you own some, check the dump's dlc folder.
column5: The game did not detect any add-on content. If you own DLC for this game, make sure its files are in the dump dlc folder and tap ⋯ › Prepare again.

column4: The game ended by itself (a normal exit).
column5: The game exited normally as requested. No action is needed.
